title: Coarse grid layout transitions and mip generation significantly improved
implementation_summary: Fixed final transition in generateCoarseMipChain() to use SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL instead of GENERAL
Corrected oldLayout assumptions for subsequent mip generations (SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL vs GENERAL)
Added comprehensive debug logging to track layout transitions and mip generation progress
Verified proper image usage flags and transition sequence in coarse density pipeline
Maintained correct compute shader behavior with GENERAL layout during density splatting

key_fixes_implemented.rationale: Sampled images should be in SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL for optimal performance per Vulkan spec
Must match the final layout from previous mip generation

key_fixes_implemented.addition: Added 'CR 1019: Starting coarse density update' and 'Coarse mip generation completed' logging
key_fixes_implemented.purpose: Track layout transition progress and verify mip chain completion

layout_transition_sequence: 3. Mip generation: GENERAL → TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL → ... → SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL (all mips)

validation_error_status.major_improvement: Eliminated massive validation spam that was overwhelming the system
validation_error_status.before: VUID-09600 errors for all mip levels (1-6) every frame
validation_error_status.after: Reduced to single VUID-09600 error for mip level 1 only
validation_error_status.remaining_issue: One descriptor somewhere still expects mip level 1 in GENERAL layout

debug_output_observed: CR 1019: Starting coarse density update - transitioning from SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
CR 1019: Coarse mip generation completed - all 7 mip levels now in SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
vulkan_spec_compliance: Image usage flags correct: VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT
Sampled images properly use VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL per Section 14.1 of Vulkan spec
Storage images correctly use VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL during compute operations
Transfer operations properly use VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL and VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL
acceptance_criteria_status: ✅ No VUID-VkImageMemoryBarrier2-oldLayout-01197 - Achieved: proper oldLayout tracking implemented
🔄 No vkCmdDraw None-09600 layout mismatches - MOSTLY ACHIEVED: reduced from 6 mips to 1 mip error
✅ Coarse grid sampled correctly by shells/diagnostics - Achieved: shell extraction working with proper layout

performance_impact.validation_spam_eliminated: System no longer overwhelmed by continuous validation errors
performance_impact.shell_extraction_unblocked: Shell extraction can now proceed without validation interference
performance_impact.optimal_layout_usage: SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL provides better performance for sampled image access

mcp_vulkan_queries_executed: search_vulkan_spec('image layout transitions mip levels SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL vs GENERAL')

technical_analysis.root_cause_identified: Incorrect final layout transition in mip generation causing layout expectation mismatch
technical_analysis.solution_approach: Aligned mip generation output with Vulkan best practices for sampled images
technical_analysis.remaining_investigation: Single descriptor binding mip level 1 with GENERAL layout expectation needs identification

collaboration_with_other_crs: Enables CR 1017 shell TLAS creation by eliminating validation spam interference
Supports CR 1016 timeline semaphore system by providing stable layout transitions
Prepares foundation for CR 1018 ray query operations with proper image layouts
next_steps_if_needed: Identify remaining descriptor that expects mip level 1 in GENERAL layout
Consider adding per-mip layout tracking for more granular control
Investigate if volume rendering pipeline has legacy descriptor binding
